pitfalls: Every DONE-gate artifact binds to storyFilesHash and nearly every producing command auto-commits, so earning them sequentially re-stales the ones already earned; record dev_memory_finish_decision first, then earn all evidence with no intervening commit of your own. The certification window needs a FINALIZED UNCONSUMED inventory receipt, and story_advance --phase=DEV consumes it. The 116-command validate suite exceeds the flat 900s story_advance watchdog, so earn a standalone PASS under a raised watchdog and let the gate reuse it.
